conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Hey, I’m good! Just the other day, I was out walking and a loud noise from a passing car caught me off guard. It made my heart race and brought back some memories I’d rather not have.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: How did you feel in the moments right after the loud noise occurred?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: Right after that noise, I felt this overwhelming rush of anxiety. My thoughts spiraled, and I couldn't shake the feeling that something was wrong. I had to take a moment to breathe, but it was like my mind was racing with images that I thought I'd left behind.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: What specific thoughts or images came to mind during that rush of anxiety?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: During that rush, I kept seeing flashes of a past incident, almost like it was happening all over again. I thought about the chaos of that day, how out of control everything felt. It was like a reel of unwanted memories playing in my head, and I couldn't just switch it off.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: How did you cope with those flashbacks at that moment?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: In the moment, I just tried to ground myself by focusing on my surroundings, like the colors of the flowers around me. I also took some deep breaths, but it felt like I was battling against a tide of those memories washing over me. I wanted to escape, to run away from that feeling, but I stayed put and just waited it out.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: What did you notice about your physical sensations while you were grounding yourself?

conversation.speaker: client
conversation.text: While I was grounding myself, I noticed my heart was pounding in my chest, and my palms were sweaty. It was as if my body was still in that chaotic moment, feeling tense and ready to react. I could feel my breath getting a bit shallow, but focusing on the flowers helped some.

conversation.speaker: bot
conversation.text: After you were able to ground yourself, how did your physical sensations change?
